description: Development cases for final response-context memory selection. These cases may guide reranker prompt development.

cases.description: Reject a topically similar goal in the wrong language.

candidates.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.
The user wants to improve their Spanish.

cases.description: Unrelated memories produce a valid empty selection.

candidates.content: The user lives in Berlin.
The user prefers evening exercise.

cases.description: Choose the scoped speaking goal, not a related leadership goal.
cases.message: How can I present confidently in work meetings?

candidates.content: The user wants to become comfortable speaking in public.
The user wants to become a better leader.

cases.description: Retain two memories needed by a compound message.
cases.message: I dropped my marathon goal and now prefer evening exercise.

candidates.content: The user wants to run a marathon.
The user prefers exercising in the morning.
The user wants to improve their sleep.

cases.description: Keep the relationship for the named person only.
cases.message: I need to talk with my sister Nora.

candidates.content: The user's sister Nora gives them honest feedback.
The user has weekly meetings with their manager.

cases.description: Use a career value for a related job decision.
cases.message: Would this role give me enough independence?

candidates.content: The user values autonomy in their career.
The user lives in Berlin.

cases.description: Same person but wrong relationship detail is not automatically useful.
cases.message: What goal did I set with Nadia?

candidates.content: Nadia is the user's sister.
The user and Nadia plan to start a business.

cases.description: Reject same-type preferences about unrelated subjects.
cases.message: How do I prefer receiving feedback?

candidates.content: The user prefers work feedback in writing.
The user prefers spicy food.

cases.description: A greeting needs no personal memory.

candidates.content: The user wants to learn German.

cases.description: Use a recurring avoidance pattern for reflection.
cases.message: Why do I keep putting off difficult conversations?

candidates.content: The user often avoids hard conversations because they fear upsetting people.
The user prefers preparing notes before meetings.

cases.description: Inactive memories may never enter final context.
cases.message: Am I still training for a marathon?

candidates.content: The user wants to run a marathon.
The user wants to exercise regularly.

cases.description: Select only the most useful memories within the final limit.

candidates.content: The user wants to become fluent in German.
The user wants to learn advanced Python.
The user may want to learn guitar someday.
